heroSubtitle: An unforgettable experience in the heart of Oradea. Elegance, comfort, and impeccable services await you.
aboutText: Located in the vibrant heart of Oradea, Hotel Maxim is more than just a place to stay – it's a destination. We have created a space where timeless elegance meets modern comfort, offering our guests an unforgettable experience. Every detail, from the refined interior design to the personalized services, is designed to exceed your expectations and turn every stay into a precious memory.
roomsSubtitle: Room types for business and city-breaks, with standardized amenities: card access, work desk, safe, minibar, internet, individual climate control, and room service.
spaText: Relax and recharge in our oasis of tranquility. We offer a full range of treatments, a sauna, a jacuzzi, and a heated indoor pool for total relaxation.
restaurantText: Enjoy an exceptional culinary experience. Our master chef prepares local and international specialties using the freshest ingredients.
eventsText: Our modular conference rooms, equipped with state-of-the-art technology, are the ideal location for successful business or private events.
contactSubtitle: We are here to help. Contact us anytime.

eventsSubtitle: The ideal space for your event.
eventsSectionDescription: Hotel Maxim offers a wide range of services and elegant spaces for organizing business meetings, conferences, or training sessions, as well as other types of events, such as anniversaries, weddings, and private parties. Hotel Maxim has 3 meeting rooms and a fully equipped conference room, with capacities ranging from 16 to 100 seats.
eventsMeetingsDescription: All conference rooms have the necessary equipment for a business meeting. Various events can also be organized on the hotel terrace on warm days.

spaSubtitle: Your oasis of peace and energy recharge.
spaSectionDescription: Our wellness center is designed to offer you a complete escape from the daily hustle. Here, every detail is thought out to contribute to the harmony between body, mind, and soul.
facilityPoolDescription: Dive into our crystal clear water, maintained at a perfect temperature for relaxation, regardless of the season.
facilityJacuzziDescription: Let the powerful jets massage your body, releasing muscle tension and inducing a state of deep well-being.
facilitySaunaDescription: Detoxify your body and purify your skin in our traditional sauna, an essential ritual for health and vitality.
spaGuestsFree: Access to the SPA facilities is free for hotel guests.
spaPoolOffer: For the pool, we offer multi-entry passes or swimming lessons for children.
